notes.title: Oh! Robot Demo
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610093/6ba8b27681b2ebdb24325868c12ca53c3280fdb5.png[/img]
Hello, gamers!

I’m excited to announce the release of the demo version of my game.
The game I’ve been working on is a top-down shooter where a young girl pilots a mech and battles against rampaging robots.

I’m incredibly excited to launch "Oh! Robot Demo" on Steam at 12:00 AM (PDT) on May 22.

Developing a game on my own has been a journey filled with questions—Is this the right path? 
Am I heading in the right direction? The game is still a work in progress, and I need your support. 
Your feedback will be invaluable, and I’ll do my best to reflect your suggestions in the game’s development.

Thank you!
